why.title: Why Invicta?
why.subtitle: Why a decentralized dVPN?
why.description: Traditional VPNs are run by a single company that controls all servers. You trust them not to log, not to share your data, not to cave to government pressure. With a decentralized dVPN, trust is replaced by technology.

points.title: No owner
points.text: The network consists of thousands of independent nodes operated by people like you. No company controls the servers.

points.title: Zero logs by design
points.text: The trustless blockchain architecture makes it impossible to store activity logs. It's not a promise — it's a technical impossibility.

points.title: Open source
points.text: All code is public and auditable by anyone. Security through transparency, not obscurity.

points.title: Anonymous payment
points.text: Pay only with cryptocurrency ($P2P). No credit card, no personal data, no email required.

points.title: Censorship resistant
points.text: Because it's decentralized, it's impossible to block. Governments can order a company to block servers — but they can't order thousands of individuals worldwide.

points.title: Made in Portugal
points.text: Proudly created in Porto. Invicta, like our city.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions.

items.a: A dVPN (decentralized VPN) works like a traditional VPN, but instead of a company controlling all servers, the network consists of thousands of independent nodes operated by people worldwide. This eliminates the need to trust a central entity.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. Invicta doesn't need email, name or any personal data. The app generates a cryptographic wallet on your device which you use to pay and manage your sessions.
You pay with $P2P, the native token of the Sentinel blockchain. You can buy $P2P inside the app (with a credit card via Onramper) or deposit $P2P you already have in your wallet.
It's technically impossible. The Sentinel blockchain architecture means there is no central server recording your activity. It's not a promise — it's a technical impossibility.
Yes. VPNs are legal in Portugal and most countries. Invicta is a privacy tool, not a tool for illegal activities.

items.q: What's the difference between Invicta and a normal VPN?
items.a: With a normal VPN (NordVPN, ExpressVPN, etc.), a company owns all the servers and you trust them not to log your data. With Invicta, the servers belong to thousands of independent people and the blockchain technology guarantees no activity is recorded.
Currently Invicta is available only for Android (mobile and TV). iOS version is in planning.

items.q: Does Invicta work on Windows or Mac?
items.a: Currently Android only. Windows (Tauri) and Mac versions are on the roadmap.

items.q: How many nodes do you have?
items.a: Invicta uses the Sentinel network, which has thousands of active nodes in over 100 countries. Nodes are independently operated by the community.

items.q: How do I know the code is secure?
items.a: All Invicta code is open source and available on GitHub. Anyone can audit, verify, and contribute.
$P2P (formerly $DVPN) is the native token of the Sentinel blockchain. It's used to pay for VPN sessions on the network. You can buy it on decentralized exchanges like Osmosis.

items.q: How can I contribute to the project?
items.a: The project is open source on GitHub. You can report bugs, suggest features, translate, or contribute code. All help is welcome.

about.title: About Invicta VPN
about.intro: Invicta VPN was born in Porto, Portugal, with a clear mission: to free internet access. Inspired by the history of Portuguese navigators and conquerors, we created a tool that returns privacy control to those who truly matter — the user.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: In a world where online privacy is increasingly scarce, we believe internet access should be free, secure, and private for everyone. We don't ask permission. We don't depend on companies. We don't keep logs.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A future where digital privacy is the norm, not the privilege. Where browsing the internet is as free as Portuguese sailors navigating unknown seas.

values.title: Our Values
list: Radical privacy — your data is yours and no one else's
Total transparency — open source, no secrets
Decentralization — power in the hands of many, not few
Freedom — internet access without borders or censorship

tech.title: Technology
tech.text: Invicta is built on the Sentinel blockchain (Cosmos SDK), using WireGuard, V2Ray, and OpenVPN protocols for fast and secure tunnels. The code is 100% open source and auditable.

footer.disclaimer: Invicta VPN is a white-label application built on the Sentinel blockchain. We are not affiliated with or sponsored by Sentinel. The code is open source under the MIT license.
